supplementalBreakdowns.basis: SHEEO's current Grapevine download reports revised FY2024 state support collected primarily from state finance and budget officers. State support excludes capital outlays/debt service, federal funds, tuition/fees, and auxiliaries. Use rows reproduce $470,036,099 of state support.  Supplemental—not additive to IPEDS expenses, the funding-source panel, or Census code 18.
